shared_seed_audit.explanation: Default PEC broadcasts the same seed to every random variable, correlating the noisy LCAs. This is not the independent-noise benchmark.

initialization_validation.description: Construct all four LCAs with sd=0.1, then disable subsequent noise; compare four real-data trials with native Python.

all_lca_noise.validation_caveat: First-trial RT discrepancy with native LLVM remains; per-trial discrepancies are reported, not hidden by the sequence mean.

full_subject_100k_pec_objective.timing_scope: PEC parameter preparation, GPU simulation and histogram scoring; no optimizer; existing local Triton cache

gpu_profile_and_optimization.scope: Same four candidates and full 760-trial sequence as full_subject_100k_pec_objective; 100000 estimates, ordinary trial-marginal histogram; no optimizer
notes: PyTorch live allocations exclude CUDA context/code, compiler-managed local memory, allocator reservations, and desktop usage.
Timings are unprofiled medians of three warm calls, in separate serial processes; setup and first calls are separate.
Register-cap profiling is an unsuccessful experiment, not a recommended configuration.
CSI comparison uses the existing recorded 561-trial deterministic-history/window-score workload.
Fresh sequential processes on the same GPU; warm medians exclude the first repetition and compilation.
Every candidate simulates all 760 trials; 720 are scored. No observed-window stopping or latent-history substitution.
Integer bin reductions preserve exact trial densities across repeated calls and candidate batch sizes.
Smoothed materialized comparisons permit rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-8 because weights are summed per bin instead of per estimate.
Live Torch memory excludes CUDA context/code, allocator reservations, and register-spill storage.
Smoothing one continuous outcome with optional categorical outcomes is fused; multidimensional smoothing falls back.
Sampled instruction addresses are an approximate attribution of kernel activity, not exact exclusive wall-clock times.
Profiler auto-adjusted the sampling buffer to 512 MiB; overflow flag was set and final dropped-bytes metric was zero. Two passes were aggregated.
Profiler sampling buffers are additional instrument memory, excluded from ordinary fitting-memory measurements.

step_utilization_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic response-step utilization, not a speedup measurement. Includes all trials.

optimization_order.change: Vectorize independent Gaussian generation across LCA coordinates.
optimization_order.rationale: About 64% of sampled locations map to RNG. Four width-2/4 LCA draws could share four Philox invocations instead of ten.
optimization_order.validation: Version or expose RNG policy: seed-to-draw mapping changes. Test Gaussian moments, cross-coordinate/component independence, replay, common random numbers, strict truncation, and full-sequence distribution parity. Compare fused and materialized scoring under the same policy.

optimization_order.change: Specialize fixed parameters and simplify redundant scheduler state.
optimization_order.rationale: 238 registers/thread limits occupancy to 25%. Classify fitted, trial-varying, controlled, and invariant values, fold safe constants, and share clocks only when typed schedule rules prove equivalence.
optimization_order.validation: Preserve RNG mapping; compare outputs and trial densities, including resets and conditional controls. Measure registers, spills, and warm runtime; retune launch geometry after reducing live state.

optimization_order.change: Prototype per-estimate trial progression after the simpler improvements.
optimization_order.rationale: Only 55-65% of 32-lane block step slots are useful in a 4096-estimate diagnostic. Let completed estimates start their next trial while carrying their own state.
optimization_order.validation: Preserve within-estimate trial order, state, trial-conditional parameters, RNG counters, masks, histogram bins and diagnostics. Account for scattered input loads and histogram writes. This is a larger scheduling change.

notes: Hardware and PC-sampling profiles use separate warmed first-candidate launches at 100000 estimates. Nsight replay timings are not fitting-throughput measurements.
An all-instruction instrumented profile was stopped for excessive overhead and contributes no measurements.
Step utilization uses unchanged materialized trajectories at 4096 estimates for all four proposals; block sizes 32/64/128 are post-hoc groupings, not new timing measurements.
The CPU copy event mostly waits for the simulation kernel; measured GPU copies total about 57 microseconds.
Optimization suggestions are a plan; no additional compiler optimization was implemented during this profile.
